title: krn standards query answers the records for what a session is doing
body:
Source: .krn/runs/brain-research/north-star.md missing item 1 (operator confirmed 2026-11-15: "lecimy z punktem 1")
Why: the brain matches standards once at session start in 400 tokens (src/hook/session-standards.ts); a session cannot ask for the records that apply to what it is doing now, the Context7-style on-demand retrieval the thesis requires.
Outcome: `krn standards query "<what I am doing>" [--file PATH]... [--stack S] [--budget TOKENS] [--json]` prints at most N ranked records (id, text, why) scoped by stack, paths and terms, reusing the packet selection in src/brain/packet.ts (one ranking owner), excludes holdout records, logs each shown record to the exposure log with moment "query", exit 0 with "no matching record" when none.
Files: src/brain/packet.ts, src/brain/standards-cli.ts, src/brain/exposures.ts, src/cli/help.ts, test/brain/
Proof: on three fixture queries (a PHP REST endpoint, a TS async handler, a WP template) the planted relevant record ranks in the top 3; output stays within --budget; exposures.jsonl gains a "query" row.
Predicted: proof precedent >= 1
